slides.text: Borkena reports **PM Abiy** told parliament Ethiopia has **no plans to invade Eritrea** and favours **peace and dialogue**.
Fides reports about **one million people** remain displaced in **Tigray** and nearly **four million need aid**, citing **October figures**.
Addis Standard reports an **MP urged a treason law** against Ethiopians accused of accepting **Egypt's support** to destabilize Ethiopia.

slides.title: Back tomorrow at 11 PM.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Sources: Borkena, Fides and Addis Standard via allAfrica (Nov 26, 2026)
